verdicts.reason: A: the CTA 'Find It Near You' is shrunk into a pill at the top-left, ahead of the headline, so the reading order is broken. The badge row wraps and misaligns, and the can is tiny. The big circle is cut off and sits behind the headline and tagline, which hurts legibility. The brand name 'GLACIER' falls below the headline, and there is a large dead area at the bottom. B: it keeps the circle-and-can hero, a brand-headline-copy-badges-CTA order, and a prominent CTA. Flaws: the text column has an awkward indent. The badges and CTA are offset and not aligned to the copy's left edge. 'GLACIER' floats alone at the top, detached from the headline. There is a big empty gap at the top right and bottom left, and the can sits slightly off-centre in its circle.
